folds.heading: ## World draft bodies and completed local queue review, 2026-11-04 (B69)
folds.body: The seven [world draft lenses](audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b69.json), items 1–12 each, now have body-level dispositions alongside B67’s character and B68’s dialogue work. All 21 saved draft files/252 bodies were read in this continuous review; this supersedes only the queue’s title-level coverage limit, not source/canon/runtime proof. Preserve optional experience, onboarding, readable noncolor meaning, long-play history, bounded cost/profile and meaningful failure-case ideas in their current owners. Draft absence claims are unconfirmed. Reject universal entity/playtime/branch quotas, equal cross-world balance, mandatory diminishing returns, automatic paused-world regeneration, forced new mysteries, compulsory fullworld prerequisites and permissions that prevent working means. A completed arc can stay complete, an unfinished one can remain unresolved, and long world stays remain valid under ACR1. Shared software follows AD51 and world-owned laws/carriers, not universal weight/timezone fields. Loading/progress/error copy must reflect actual state; no fabricated ETA or swallowing invalid publication. Raw ID copy can be corrected independently of a full localization rollout; desktop readability/accessibility is not deferred merely because mobile is. Existing source attribution, authority, compatibility and proportional proof owners remain, with proposals under AD32 and checks under AD36.

folds.heading: ## All saved draft bodies reviewed, 2026-11-04 (B69)
folds.body: The original “titles alone” statement remains the October 20 history. B67/B68/B69 now freshly reviewed all 21 saved output files and all 252 numbered item bodies, retaining per-file/ordinal dispositions and useful variants. [World body dispositions](../reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b69.json) complete this finite queue; no rawsource reading, proven runtime defect, newfeature adoption or localmodel quality verdict follows. The old eight-novel-leads estimate is not a verified novelty count for these bodies. Companion/rival/dialogue/deep-world owners now carry the material qualifications; originals stay available. This closes body reading of this queue, while unrelated inventories and partial receiving owners remain open. No model rerun, successor, deletion or gameplay wave is selected (AD32/AD36).
